entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: The parser rejects bool on non-comparison operators. lowerDateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp receives the identical binary node returned by dateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp; lowerScalarArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp receives the node from scalarArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp; lowerSortFloatOperand receives the node from sortOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp. Each recognizer delegates to mixedExpHistogramSetOp, which requires parser.LOR. None replaces the node before shadowResolveFloatArmChecked. LOR is a set union, never a comparison, so the parsed AST cannot carry ReturnBool. The sort operand policy authorizes the same checked loader without changing its AST or shadow resolution. This guard is reachable only through internal malformed-AST construction.
